ambiguous_strings: Retained retired_label uses historical 退役 unchanged by explicit instruction; new whole messages use clearer update attribution.

known_programme_gap: Unknown nonempty external diagnostics still retain legacy English outside this namespace. Stored prose untouched; no all-status-copy-complete claim.
